scope.source_of_truth: filesystem bytes in the selected checkout

steps: normalize Unicode with NFKC for comparison text
casefold and collapse whitespace for similarity tokens only
preserve JSON object values and field content for content_sha256
normalization.content_hash_boundary: content_sha256 uses sorted JSON keys for cards and line-ending-normalized question body bytes for exams; no semantic rewriting is applied

similarity.candidate_generation: shared-token inverted index followed by exact Jaccard calculation

distinct.interpretation: No exact collision and no candidate met the configured explicit metric; this is not proof of semantic or didactic uniqueness.

boundaries: duplicate_exact means only that content_sha256 is equal for two or more indexed units; it is not an automatic deletion or merge decision.
candidate_review means the explicit token_set_jaccard score meets the configured threshold; a human must inspect provenance, purpose and content.
distinct means no configured signal was emitted, not that semantic, educational, factual, legal or licensing equivalence has been proven.
Cards and exam questions are compared only within their source group; a question derived from a card is not automatically a duplicate.
The audit does not inspect answer keys, decide correctness, or modify didactic files.
